content_sections.heading: Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Qualification: PG in Materials Science/Physics/Photonics with a Valid GATE/NET Age limit: Maximum 35 years (as on last date of submission of the application) Age relaxation: SC/ST/OBC As per Government of India norms Other conditions: Candidate needs to prepare and characterize polymer ceramic composites Candidate needs to work with computational solvers such as CST Studio Suite and COMSOL Multiphysics (basic training will be given)

content_sections.text: 1 Year on contract basis Extendable based on the performance of the candidate and availability of the project fund Selected candidates are encouraged to register for a Ph.D. at NIT Calicut

content_sections.text: Shortlisting of applications Online interview After shortlisting, eligible candidates will be notified by email and invited for the online interview Online interview tentatively on 15-12-2026

content_sections.heading: Documents to Enclose
content_sections.text: Duly filled registration form Most recent CV Soft copies of mark sheets/certificates supporting academic qualification/experience Photograph No Objection Certificate from the employer at the time of interview (for those already employed)

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for NIT Calicut Recruitment 2026 by Email
content_sections.text: Fill the registration form annexed to the notice. Attach the most recent CV and soft copies of mark sheets/certificates supporting academic qualification/experience. Consolidate all soft copies into a single PDF document. E-mail it with the subject line "Application for JRF-DRDO-DFTM-/MED/KPM-011", with a copy to [email protected] . Email it on or before 10 December 2026.

content_sections.heading: Other Points to Note
content_sections.text: The Institute reserves the right to relax qualification and experience for candidates with exceptional credentials Applicants already employed (government or any other organization) must submit a No Objection Certificate at the time of interview No TA/DA will be paid for appearing in the interview Applicant is responsible for the authenticity of information, documents and photograph submitted Queries: Dr. Murali K P, [email protected]

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for NIT Calicut Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date is 10 December 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in NIT Calicut Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There is 1 vacancy for Junior Research Fellow.

faq.question: Q3. How do I apply for NIT Calicut Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: By email to [email protected], on or before 10 December 2026. There is no online form.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The maximum age is 35 years (as on last date of submission of the application). Relaxation: SC/ST/OBC As per Government of India norms.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Rs.37,000 per month (Consolidated) + 20% HRA = Rs. 44,400 per month.

faq.question: Q6. What qualification is needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: PG in Materials Science/Physics/Photonics with a Valid GATE/NET.

faq.question: Q7. Are there other conditions for this recruitment besides qualification and age?
faq.answer: Yes. Candidate needs to prepare and characterize polymer ceramic composites. Candidate needs to work with computational solvers such as CST Studio Suite and COMSOL Multiphysics (basic training will be given).

faq.question: Q8. How will candidates be selected for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Shortlisting of applications. Online interview. After shortlisting, eligible candidates will be notified by email and invited for the online interview. Online interview tentatively on 15-12-2026.

faq.question: Q9. What are the terms of engagement for this recruitment?
faq.answer: 1 Year on contract basis. Extendable based on the performance of the candidate and availability of the project fund. Selected candidates are encouraged to register for a Ph.D. at NIT Calicut.
